name: Auto Eat (Deprecated)
description: This zone type is deprecated and no longer has any effect.  Auto eating during long activities has been reworked: it now automatically consumes edible food you are carrying or food lying right around you, no zone required.

name: Auto Drink (Deprecated)
description: This zone type is deprecated and no longer has any effect.  Auto drinking during long activities has been reworked: it now automatically consumes drinks you are carrying or drinks lying right around you, and can even drink clean water from vehicle water tanks through a water faucet part within reach, no zone required.

name: Disassembly Work
description: Items in this zone are marked for disassembly

name: Loot: Strip Corpses
description: Corpses in this zone you don't otherwise sort will have everything taken off them and dropped on the same tile.

name: Loot: Unload Everything
description: Any containers in this zone you don't otherwise sort will have their contents dumped out and placed on the same tile.  This includes corpses, magazines, and magazine wells.
